headlines.text: That Friday in 2024, Eddie Kingston vs. Wheeler Yuta went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.56. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Rewind to 2022, when Sammy Guevara vs. Daniel Garcia clashed for the AEW Interim TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.75. For Daniel Garcia, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Back on this day in 2024, Hikaru Shida vs. Queen Aminata crossed paths for the first time ever on Rampage, rated 6.96.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2022, Penta El Zero M vs. Matt Hardy crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 5.04.
On this day in 2022, it marked the first-ever meeting between CM Punk and Wardlow, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 5.79.
2024 brought us this moment: Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Uno vs. 2.O & Hager locked horns for the first time, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 5.34.
